items.title: New Found Glory’s Chad Gilbert Dead At 45
items.summary: Chad Gilbert, founding guitarist for the punk band New Found Glory, has died. "On the morning of September 20th, Chad Everett Gilbert passed away peacefully in his sleep," the band announced in a statement today.

items.title: Warner Chappell COO and Co-Chair Carianne Marshall to Depart
items.summary: Guy Moot, the publisher's CEO, will become Warner Chappell's sole chairman, the company said Monday.

items.title: Read The Proposed Consent Decree To Settle The Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery Merger
items.summary: As entertainment figures and politicos weigh in on the settlement of the Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger, the parties submitted details of a consent decree for a judge’s approval.
